name: v2-inch-units
covers: G20 inch units followed by G21 millimetres
review: One inch equals 25.4 mm or 2032 steps at 80 steps/mm. X and Y each advance 2032 steps, then both reverse 2032 steps after G21. F120 in inch mode is 50.8 mm/s, and F3000 in millimetre mode is 50 mm/s. At 100 mm/s^2 and the source-defined 0.05 mm junction deviation, the 90-degree and 135-degree turns give about 3.474 and 1.761 mm/s. Continuous profiles give durations 0.97442, 0.95712 and 1.20112 s versus 0.97423, 0.95664 and 1.19847 s recorded, differing by at most 0.23%. Two simulator runs produced identical output; discrete pulse timing and physical hardware remain unverified.
